messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync — need to prioritize VPC/on‑prem packaging + upgrade path work for H2. Customer asks are piling up, and we need a clear scope.
ryan (Eng): Can you list the top asks? I'm assuming automatic upgrades vs manual, DB/model-store migration, network setup, KMS/HSM integration, and air‑gapped packaging.
tess (Solutions): From pilots: top 3 are (1) clear upgrade story (canary + rollback), (2) simple VPC peering + terraform module and example, (3) cert/key rotation via customer KMS.
sam (Sales): +1 on 1 & 3 — those are deal blockers. Also customers want configurable upgrade windows and basic SLA language. Typical onboarding expectation: 6–8 weeks.
liam (Infra): Current private package is docker images + helm. For on‑prem we need an offline bundle (images + manifests) with checksums, an installer, and preflight checks. Upgrade path demands migration tooling for model-store metadata/schema.
ryan (Eng): Proposal: split into three epics — Packaging (offline bundles, installer, terraform examples), Upgrade Paths (canary, rollback, migrations, dry‑run), Networking/KMS (VPC peering, private networking docs, KMS/HSM integration). Each epic should have explicit launch criteria.
maya (PM): Draft launch criteria idea: Packaging = installer that completes <2h on reference cluster, bundle verification (sha256), and docs + quickstart; Upgrade = canary rollout with automatic rollback on health fail, migration dry‑run and rollback plan; Networking/KMS = validated KMS integration + network security checklist and terraform module.
tess (Solutions): Add a test matrix: air‑gapped install, rolling upgrade test, canary traffic split validation, KMS key rotation test. I can supply two pilot customers for validation once we have MVP.
ryan (Eng): Rough eng estimates: Packaging 4w, Upgrade paths 6w (migrations add complexity), Networking/KMS 3w. We can parallelize Packaging + KMS. Total ~13w if serial, ~8–9w if parallel for core bits.
sam (Sales): Can we offer a minimal on‑prem option to get customers started sooner? Call it 'MVP‑onprem' — offline bundle + manual upgrade docs + basic VPC guide. That would remove automatic canary but unblock deals.
liam (Infra): MVP‑onprem sounds feasible. Deliverable: offline tarball of images + manifests, installer script, preflight checks, and manual upgrade steps. That should cut ~6 weeks off the full timeline.
maya (PM): Decision proposal: ship MVP‑onprem to pilots in 6 weeks; run upgrade‑path work in parallel targeting canary + rollback in the following 7 weeks. Owners: ryan -> packaging, liam -> upgrade infra/migrations, tess -> pilots/acceptance, maya -> PM/coordination.
ryan (Eng): I'll open a spec PR today listing installer flow, artifact format (tar.gz of images + manifest.json), verification steps, and preflight checks. Will include example terraform for a simple VPC peering flow.
tess (Solutions): I'll prepare pilot acceptance criteria and a test checklist. Also request SE on‑call support for the first two rollouts :phone:.
deploy-bot: Reminder: infra standup tomorrow 10:00 — please add items: private‑deploy packaging, migration plan, pilot readiness.
maya (PM): Thanks — I'll create the tracker epics and a prioritization doc with ACs. If anyone hits blockers, ping me.
